$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Optional JSON schema reference for editor IntelliSense/validation.

version.title: Config schema version
version.description: Configuration schema version for forward compatibility. Bumped only when the config shape changes incompatibly.

worldId.title: World ID
worldId.description: Stable GUID identifying this BotNexus world. Generated automatically on first start; do not copy it between installations.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agent definitions keyed by agent ID.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Provider configurations keyed by provider name.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel settings keyed by channel name.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for gateway authentication. Null runs the gateway in dev mode with no auth. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Cron scheduler settings and optional seed jobs.

promptTemplates.title: Prompt templates
promptTemplates.description: Named prompt templates for CLI rendering and cron template resolution.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace and portal display settings (reports, file viewer limits).

FeatureManagement.title: Feature flags
FeatureManagement.description: Feature flags keyed by name. Each declared flag should carry an explicit true/false; run 'botnexus doctor config' to report any that are absent.

listenUrl.title: Listen URL
listenUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL the gateway binds to (for example http://localhost:5005). Supports Kestrel wildcards such as http://+:5000.

publicBaseUrl.title: Public base URL
publicBaseUrl.description: External base URL the portal is reached on (for example https://portal.example.com). Used to build canvas deep links. Leave unset on a purely local install.

defaultAgentId.title: Default agent
defaultAgentId.description: Agent ID to route to when an incoming message does not specify one.

agentsDirectory.title: Agents directory
agentsDirectory.description: Directory holding per-agent workspaces and configuration. Relative paths resolve against the BotNexus home directory.

sessionsDirectory.title: Sessions directory
sessionsDirectory.description: Directory holding session transcripts and the session store database.

sessionStore.title: Session store
sessionStore.description: Backend used to persist sessions and conversation history.

walCheckpointIntervalMinutes.title: WAL checkpoint interval (min)
walCheckpointIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between periodic PASSIVE SQLite WAL checkpoints. A TRUNCATE checkpoint also runs on graceful shutdown. Default 30.

subAgents.title: Sub-agents
subAgents.description: Limits on sub-agent spawning, including per-parent turn and timeout budgets.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Controls when a long session is summarised to stay within the model context window.

toolResultPersistence.title: Tool result persistence
toolResultPersistence.description: Write-time cap on the size of individual tool results persisted to session history.

toolOutputBudget.title: Tool output budget
toolOutputBudget.description: Limits on how much output a single tool result may contribute before it is truncated.

readTool.title: Read tool
readTool.description: Settings governing the built-in file read tool, including paging limits.

claimAudit.title: Claim audit
claimAudit.description: Post-turn auditor that checks an agent's stated outcomes against the tool calls it actually made.

memoryEmbeddings.title: Memory embeddings
memoryEmbeddings.description: Embedding backend supplying vectors for hybrid memory retrieval. Absent or disabled keeps retrieval lexical-only.

memory.title: Shared memory
memory.description: Named memory stores that more than one agent can read or write, each with its own access list.

cors.title: CORS
cors.description: Cross-origin request rules for browser-based clients reaching the gateway API.

rateLimit.title: Rate limiting
rateLimit.description: Per-client request rate limits applied to gateway API calls.

signalR.title: SignalR transport
signalR.description: Hub transport limits: maximum frame size, parallel invocations, and stream buffer capacity.

secretRedaction.title: Secret redaction
secretRedaction.description: Settings controlling how secrets are detected and masked in logs and tool output.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.description: Minimum log level override. One of Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Multi-tenant API keys keyed by key ID. Each entry authorises a caller and scopes what it may reach.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Dynamic extension loading: whether extensions load, from where, and their world-level defaults.

world.title: World identity
world.description: Name and identity of this world as shown by gateway clients and used in cross-world federation.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Named locations registry used for resource management and path resolution.

crossWorldPermissions.title: Cross-world permissions
crossWorldPermissions.description: Explicit grants controlling which remote worlds may communicate with this one.

crossWorld.title: Cross-world federation
crossWorld.description: Gateway-to-gateway federation settings enabling communication between worlds.

fileAccess.title: File access policy
fileAccess.description: Default read, write and deny path rules applied to every agent unless the agent overrides them.

shellPreference.title: Shell preference
shellPreference.description: Preferred shell on Windows: auto (bash when available, PowerShell otherwise), pwsh, or bash. Ignored on non-Windows platforms.

toolEnvironmentPassThrough.title: Tool environment pass-through
toolEnvironmentPassThrough.description: Extra environment variable names exposed to bash and exec child processes. Tool subprocesses otherwise receive a fixed allow-list that carries no credentials. Do not add anything that authenticates.

shellCommand.title: Shell command
shellCommand.description: Explicit shell argv array. Element 0 is the executable; the command string is appended last. Overrides Shell preference entirely when set.

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update
autoUpdate.description: Settings for the gateway updating itself via the BotNexus CLI.

auxiliary.title: Auxiliary model
auxiliary.description: Cheap, fast model used for background gateway tasks such as conversation title generation.

defaultTimezone.title: Default timezone
defaultTimezone.description: Server-wide default IANA timezone ID used when an agent has no timezone configured. Falls back to UTC when blank or invalid.

enableProviderRequestLogging.title: Log provider requests
enableProviderRequestLogging.description: When on, all provider HTTP requests and responses are logged at Debug level. Auth headers are always redacted. For debugging only.

dateTimeInjection.title: Datetime injection
dateTimeInjection.description: World default for prepending the current datetime to user messages. Per-agent settings take precedence.

satellites.title: Satellites
satellites.description: Registered satellite nodes keyed by satellite ID. Satellites connect for notifications, canvas rendering and optional remote execution.

type.title: Type
type.description: Store type. Supported values: InMemory, File, or Sqlite.

filePath.title: File path
filePath.description: Path used by file-based session store implementation.

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: Connection string for the session store. Sensitive: contains credentials and is stored and shown masked.

maxConcurrentPerSession.title: Max concurrent per session
maxConcurrentPerSession.description: Maximum number of concurrent sub-agents allowed per parent session.

defaultMaxTurns.title: Default max turns
defaultMaxTurns.description: Default maximum turn budget applied to sub-agent runs when a spawn request does not specify one.

maxTurnsCeiling.title: Max turns ceiling
maxTurnsCeiling.description: Hard upper bound for an agent-supplied maxTurns on a spawn request. A value of zero or less disables the ceiling.

defaultTimeoutSeconds.title: Default timeout (seconds)
defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout, in seconds, applied to sub-agent runs when a spawn request does not specify one.

maxTimeoutSeconds.title: Max timeout (seconds)
maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Hard upper bound, in seconds, for an agent-supplied timeoutSeconds on a spawn request. A value of zero or less disables the ceiling.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Default model for sub-agent runs. Empty uses the parent agent's model.

completedRecordRetentionMinutes.title: Completed record retention (minutes)
completedRecordRetentionMinutes.description: How long, in minutes, a finished sub-agent record is retained in memory for status queries. A value of zero or less disables time-based eviction.

maxRetainedCompletedRecords.title: Max retained completed records
maxRetainedCompletedRecords.description: Maximum number of completed sub-agent records to retain regardless of age. A value of zero or less disables the cap.

workspaceRoot.title: Workspace root
workspaceRoot.description: Temporary root directory for sub-agent workspaces. Empty uses <OS temp>/botnexus-subagent-workspaces. Supports ~ and environment-variable expansion.

parentOverrides.title: Parent budget overrides
parentOverrides.description: Trusted sub-agent budget overrides keyed by spawning parent agent ID.

defaultTimeoutSeconds.title: Default timeout seconds
defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Gets or sets the default timeout in seconds.

maxTimeoutSeconds.title: Max timeout seconds
maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Gets or sets the timeout ceiling in seconds.

defaultMaxTurns.title: Default max turns
defaultMaxTurns.description: Default turn budget applied to a spawned sub-agent when the caller does not specify one.

maxTurnsCeiling.title: Max turns ceiling
maxTurnsCeiling.description: Hard upper bound on a sub-agent's turn budget. A caller requesting more is clamped to this value.

maxConcurrentPerSession.title: Max concurrent per session
maxConcurrentPerSession.description: Gets or sets the maximum concurrent sub-agents per parent session.

preservedTurns.title: Preserved turns
preservedTurns.description: Number of most recent user turns to preserve verbatim (default: 3).

maxSummaryChars.title: Max summary chars
maxSummaryChars.description: Maximum characters for the compaction summary (default: 16000).

tokenThresholdRatio.title: Token threshold ratio
tokenThresholdRatio.description: Token threshold as a fraction of context window (0.0-1.0) at which auto-compaction triggers (default: 0.6).

contextWindowTokens.title: Context window tokens
contextWindowTokens.description: Approximate context window size in tokens for the model (default: 128000).

largestEntryBytesThreshold.title: Largest entry bytes threshold
largestEntryBytesThreshold.description: Per-entry size (in UTF-8 bytes) at or above which a single visible history entry makes the session eligible for compaction, independently of the token-count threshold (#1599 — bloat-aware trigger). A session can accumulate a small number of enormous low-value entries (e.g. a raw transcript dump or a directory listing) whose total still sits under TokenThresholdRatio while the visible tail is dominated by dead weight. This signal is additive: whichever of the token-count threshold or this per-entry byte threshold trips first triggers compaction. Only LLM-visible entries are considered (historical / already-summarised entries are excluded, exactly like the token trigger). Default: 65536 (64 KiB). Values <= 0 disable the byte-based trigger, restoring the pre-#1599 token-count-only behaviour.

summarizationModel.title: Summarization model
summarizationModel.description: Model to use for summarization. If null, uses the session's model.

summarizationProvider.title: Summarization provider
summarizationProvider.description: Provider to use for summarization (e.g., "github-copilot"). If null, auto-detected from registered providers.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the LLM summarization call to complete before aborting compaction (default: 90). Prevents hung provider calls from blocking the session indefinitely. The timeout is enforced via a linked CancellationToken that cancels the wait on the provider response.

circuitBreakerCooldownSeconds.title: Circuit breaker cooldown seconds
circuitBreakerCooldownSeconds.description: How long (seconds) the per-session compaction circuit breaker stays open after MaxConsecutiveFailures consecutive failures, before it auto-resets and compaction is attempted again (default: 600 = 10 minutes). The previous behaviour kept the breaker open until the gateway restarted, which let a transient provider outage permanently wedge a session (it could no longer shed context). A bounded cooldown lets the session recover on its own once the provider issue clears. Values <= 0 fall back to the default.

cronLlmIdleTimeoutMs.title: Cron llm idle timeout ms
cronLlmIdleTimeoutMs.description: Stream-setup idle cap (milliseconds) applied to the compaction summarization model call when the resolved candidate is a CLOUD provider (default: 60000 = 60s, mirroring OpenClaw's CRON_LLM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS). This wires the otherwise-inert StreamOptions.StreamSetupTimeoutMs first-token watchdog so a cloud model that stalls mid-stream (or never emits a first token) is aborted early. Compaction is a background (non-interactive) call that already has an outer per-attempt watchdog (TimeoutSeconds); the stream stall must fail well INSIDE that window so the model fallback chain still has time to try the next candidate rather than the whole attempt timing out. The cap is intentionally NOT applied to LOCAL/self-hosted providers (localhost / 127.0.0.1 - e.g. ollama, vllm, lmstudio, sglang) because those endpoints are legitimately slow to warm up; the cloud-vs-local decision is made via ProviderEndpointClassifier.IsLocalProviderBaseUrl from the resolved model BaseUrl. Values <= 0 disable the cap entirely (restores the pre-#1652 behaviour where no setup-phase timeout is enforced).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether memory flush is enabled (default: true).

promptText.title: Prompt text
promptText.description: The prompt sent to the agent during the pre-compaction flush turn.

sessionEndPromptText.title: Session end prompt text
sessionEndPromptText.description: The prompt sent to the agent during the session-end flush turn (on /reset or explicit session close).

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the flush turn to complete (default: 60).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the write-time tool-result cap is enabled. Defaults to .

maxBytes.title: Max bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte size of a single persisted tool result. Results larger than this are truncated at write time with a [truncated N bytes] marker. Defaults to 16384 (16 KiB). A value of 0 or less disables truncation even when Enabled is true.

enabled.title: Enable tool output budget
enabled.description: Bounds every tool result returned to the model, regardless of which tool produced it. Defaults to enabled.

maxBytes.title: Max tool output bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte size of a single tool result returned to the model. Defaults to 262144 (256 KiB). Zero or less disables the backstop.

largeReadThresholdBytes.title: Large read threshold bytes
largeReadThresholdBytes.description: UTF-8 byte size above which a read result carries a size indicator naming offset and limit. Defaults to 20480 (20 KiB). Zero or less disables it.

elideUnchangedRereads.title: Elide unchanged re-reads
elideUnchangedRereads.description: Return a short marker instead of the full body when the same slice of an unchanged file is re-read in one session. A changed file always returns fresh content.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the post-turn claim auditor runs. Defaults to .

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Reaction on detecting an unbacked claim: "warn" (emit an observable signal only, the safe default) or "block" (also mark the turn as one that should be blocked). Unrecognised values fall back to "warn".

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Embedding backend: 'none' for lexical-only retrieval, 'local' for on-box inference, or 'provider' to reuse a configured provider's embeddings endpoint. Defaults to 'none'.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether memory entries are embedded for hybrid (lexical + vector) retrieval. Off by default; enabling it sends memory content to the configured embeddings endpoint.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Provider key whose embeddings endpoint supplies vectors (for example 'ollama' or 'openai').

model.title: Model
model.description: Embedding model identifier as the endpoint expects it (for example 'nomic-embed-text' or 'text-embedding-3-small').

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Number of components in each vector the model emits. A response of a different width is discarded and the entry falls back to lexical-only.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (the '/embeddings' path is appended).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Bearer token for the embeddings endpoint. Optional for a local endpoint. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

sharedStores.title: Shared stores
sharedStores.description: Named memory stores shared between agents. Each store names who may read it and who may write it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique name for this store, e.g. platform-knowledge.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this store is for. Shown wherever the store is listed.

readers.title: Readers
readers.description: Agent ids allowed to read this store. Use * for every agent. Empty means nobody.

writers.title: Writers
writers.description: Agent ids allowed to write to this store. Use * for every agent. Empty means nobody.

retentionDays.title: Retention days
retentionDays.description: How many days to keep entries in this store. Leave empty to keep them indefinitely.

allowedOrigins.title: Allowed origins
allowedOrigins.description: Explicit origins allowed to access the gateway from browsers.

enabled.title: Enable rate limiting
enabled.description: Whether per-client request rate limiting is active.

requestsPerMinute.title: Requests per minute
requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum requests allowed within a window for a single client.

windowSeconds.title: Window seconds
windowSeconds.description: Window size in seconds used for request counting.

maxEntries.title: Max entries
maxEntries.description: Maximum number of distinct client windows retained in memory. Bounds the per-client tracking dictionary so a flood of distinct client keys cannot drive the gateway to memory exhaustion (a DoS against the DoS-protection itself). When the cap is reached, stale entries are pruned first, then a window that is not actively rate-limiting a client is evicted; if none can be freed, the new request is rejected with 429 rather than inserting. Windows actively counting toward a 429 are never evicted, so a flood cannot clear an attacker's own throttle. A non-positive value disables the cap.

maximumReceiveMessageSizeBytes.title: Maximum receive message size bytes
maximumReceiveMessageSizeBytes.description: Maximum size, in bytes, of a single inbound hub message. Must accommodate base64-encoded inline media (which exceeds the framework's 32 KB default) while bounding runaway frames. Non-positive values fall back to the secure default.

maximumParallelInvocationsPerClient.title: Maximum parallel invocations per client
maximumParallelInvocationsPerClient.description: Maximum number of hub method invocations a single connection may run in parallel. Bounds concurrent work a client can force on the server. Non-positive values fall back to the secure default.

streamBufferCapacity.title: Stream buffer capacity
streamBufferCapacity.description: Maximum number of items buffered for client upload streams before processing blocks. Non-positive values fall back to the secure default.

keepAliveIntervalSeconds.title: Keep alive interval seconds
keepAliveIntervalSeconds.description: Interval, in seconds, at which the server sends keep-alive pings to idle clients (#1840). Chosen to sit comfortably under the netbird tunnel idle-cutoff so a quiet mobile connection never idles the tunnel out mid-session. Non-positive values fall back to the mobile-tuned default. The server timeout (ClientTimeoutIntervalSeconds) is always coerced to at least twice this value so a single dropped ping cannot terminate the connection.

clientTimeoutIntervalSeconds.title: Client timeout interval seconds
clientTimeoutIntervalSeconds.description: Interval, in seconds, after which the server considers a client dead if no message or ping has arrived (#1840). Widened over the framework's 30s default to tolerate the jitter and brief stalls of a mobile link tunnelled through netbird. Must be at least twice KeepAliveIntervalSeconds; smaller (or non-positive) values are coerced up to the mobile-tuned default so a misconfig cannot make the server hang up prematurely.

patterns.title: Additional redaction patterns
patterns.description: Extra .NET regular expressions whose matches are replaced with [REDACTED]. Applied in addition to the built-in credential patterns, never instead of them.

matchTimeoutMilliseconds.title: Redaction match timeout (ms)
matchTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Per-pattern match timeout for operator redaction patterns. Defaults to 100ms.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The raw API key value used for gateway authentication. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

callerId.title: Caller ID
callerId.description: Caller identifier used in audit logs.

allowedAgents.title: Allowed agents
allowedAgents.description: Agent IDs this key is allowed to access. Empty means all.

isAdmin.title: Is admin
isAdmin.description: Whether this key has administrative privileges.

path.title: Path
path.description: Root directory containing extension folders with botnexus-extension.json manifests.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables or disables dynamic extension loading.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: World-level default extension configuration, keyed by extension ID. Deep-merged with agent-level overrides to produce effective config per agent.

id.title: ID
id.description: Stable identifier for this world. Used to scope agents, conversations and cross-world federation; do not change it after first start.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this world, shown in the portal and in cross-world peer listings.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of what this world is for. Presentation only; has no runtime effect.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: Emoji used to visually identify this world in the portal and in peer listings.

type.title: Type
type.description: What kind of resource this is: filesystem, api, mcp-server, database or remote-node. Determines which of the fields below are required.

path.title: Path
path.description: Filesystem path. Required for filesystem locations. A leading ~ expands to the user's home directory.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Absolute http or https URL. Required for api, mcp-server and remote-node locations.

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: Database connection string. Required for database locations. Held in full in config.json, so prefer credentialRef where the target supports it.

username.title: Username
username.description: Account to authenticate as, for example automation@pve. Stored in the clear - it is an identity, not a credential.

credentialRef.title: Credential reference
credentialRef.description: Where to find this location's credential, as scheme:identifier - for example env:PROXMOX_TOKEN or file:~/.botnexus/secrets/proxmox. This field holds a reference, never the credential itself.

verifyTls.title: Verify TLS
verifyTls.description: Verify the endpoint's TLS certificate. Turn off only for a target using a self-signed certificate, and only for that target.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agent ids allowed to see this location. Leave empty for every agent. Use * for every agent explicitly.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this location is, in a few words. Shown wherever the location is listed.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form labels for grouping and filtering, for example homelab or hypervisor.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Extra key/value settings a consumer of this location understands, for example a Proxmox node name.

targetWorldId.title: Target world ID
targetWorldId.description: Identifier of the target world this permission applies to.

allowedAgents.title: Allowed agents
allowedAgents.description: Specific agents allowed to communicate. Null means all hosted agents.

allowInbound.title: Allow inbound
allowInbound.description: Whether inbound communication from the target world is allowed.

allowOutbound.title: Allow outbound
allowOutbound.description: Whether outbound communication to the target world is allowed.

peers.title: Peers
peers.description: Known peer gateways keyed by world ID or alias.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Optional explicit cross-world agent discovery map.

worldId.title: World ID
worldId.description: Canonical world ID for this peer (defaults to dictionary key).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate to this peer world. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this peer is enabled for outbound calls.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether inbound relay endpoint is enabled.

allowedWorlds.title: Allowed worlds
allowedWorlds.description: Allowed source world IDs. Empty means no source worlds are allowed.

apiKeys.title: Inbound API keys
apiKeys.description: API keys accepted from peer worlds, keyed by peer name. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

agentId.title: Agent ID
agentId.description: Remote agent ID within the target world.

allowedReadPaths.title: Allowed read paths
allowedReadPaths.description: Paths the agent can read (exact paths or glob patterns).

allowedWritePaths.title: Allowed write paths
allowedWritePaths.description: Paths the agent can write (exact paths or glob patterns).

deniedPaths.title: Denied paths
deniedPaths.description: Paths explicitly denied even if otherwise allowed.

enabled.title: Enable auto-update
enabled.description: Enables background GitHub polling and the self-update endpoint.

checkIntervalMinutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
checkIntervalMinutes.description: How often to poll GitHub for a new commit, in minutes. Minimum 5.

repositoryOwner.title: Repository owner
repositoryOwner.description: GitHub repository owner. Defaults to sytone.

repositoryName.title: Repository name
repositoryName.description: GitHub repository name. Defaults to botnexus.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Branch to track. Defaults to main.

cliPath.title: Cli path
cliPath.description: Absolute path to the BotNexus CLI entry point used to run the update. Required when Enabled is true. If the path ends with .dll it is launched via dotnet; otherwise it is run directly.

sourcePath.title: Source path
sourcePath.description: Absolute path to the BotNexus source tree. Passed to the CLI update command as --source. Required when Enabled is true.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Update channel to forward to the CLI update command. Typical values: stable, beta, dev. When null or empty the CLI default channel is used.

shutdownDelaySeconds.title: Shutdown delay seconds
shutdownDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after returning 202 before calling StopApplication(). Minimum 1. Defaults to 2.

titling.title: Titling
titling.description: Conversation title generation settings. Hydrated by AuxiliarySchemaContributor as a nested object ({ model, timeoutSeconds }); this property must remain an object so the bound config matches the on-disk shape.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Model ID to use for session compaction summarisation (cheap/fast auxiliary model). Supports any registered provider model ID (e.g. "gpt-4o-mini", "claude-haiku-3-5"). When null or empty the primary SummarizationModel or the compactor's default waterfall is used. If the resolved auxiliary model has a smaller context window than the compaction threshold, a startup warning is emitted but the gateway continues to run.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for conversation auto-titling. When false the gateway never schedules a title-generation call and conversations keep their default title until a user or agent renames them. Defaults to true. Surfaced as config because the only prior way to disable auto-titling was to leave no models registered, which is a poor proxy for intent.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model ID to use for auto-generating conversation titles after the first user+assistant exchange. Supports any registered provider model ID (e.g. "gpt-4o-mini", "claude-haiku-3-5", "gemini-2.0-flash-lite"). When null or empty the primary session model is used as fallback.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for the best-effort title generation call before it is abandoned. Defaults to 30 seconds. A non-positive value falls back to the 30s default so a mis-set zero never produces a zero-timeout that cancels every call instantly.

enabled.title: Enable datetime injection
enabled.description: When on, the current datetime is prepended to every user message so the agent always has reliable temporal context.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone ID used when formatting the injected datetime (for example UTC or America/Los_Angeles). Falls back to the gateway default timezone, then UTC, when blank.

format.title: Datetime format
format.description: Output format for the injected datetime. Only iso8601 is supported today; rfc2822 and custom patterns are reserved for future use.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Human-readable display name for this satellite.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Platform the satellite runs on. One of windows, macos, or linux.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key the satellite uses to authenticate with the gateway. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capabilities this satellite advertises. Valid values: notify, canvas, exec. DISPLAY-ONLY - this is NOT an authorization control (#2606). Setting a narrow list here does NOT restrict what the satellite may be asked to do: nothing in the gateway reads this list to permit or refuse an operation, and there is no satellite dispatch surface for it to gate. An empty list means "no capabilities declared" and behaves identically to a fully populated one. Use Enabled to actually stop a satellite connecting.

ownerUserId.title: Owner user ID
ownerUserId.description: User ID of the satellite's owner. Events are filtered server-side to this user's conversations.

staleTimeoutSeconds.title: Stale timeout (seconds)
staleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before the satellite is marked stale.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this satellite is enabled. Disabled satellites are rejected on connect.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Human-readable display name shown for this agent in clients.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: Optional emoji shown alongside the agent name in clients.

avatarHue.title: Avatar hue
avatarHue.description: Avatar colour in degrees (0-359). Leave empty to generate one from the agent id.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.description: One short line naming what this agent owns.

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.description: What this agent must not do.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Agent-maintained summary of what this agent is currently doing. Written by the agent itself; the static description stays human-owned.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier this agent uses (for example gpt-4.1).

allowedModels.title: Allowed models
allowedModels.description: Model IDs this agent is allowed to use. Null means unrestricted within provider allowlist.

systemPromptFiles.title: System prompt files
systemPromptFiles.description: Ordered list of files to load as the system prompt. Empty = default order.

systemPromptFile.title: System prompt file
systemPromptFile.description: Path to a single system prompt file (legacy, prefer SystemPromptFiles).

toolIds.title: Tool ids
toolIds.description: Tool identifiers this agent has access to.

toolTimeoutSeconds.title: Tool timeout seconds
toolTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-tool timeout in seconds for runtime tool execution safety caps.

subAgents.title: Sub agents
subAgents.description: Agent IDs this agent can call as sub-agents.

subAgentRoles.title: Sub agent roles
subAgentRoles.description: Role names this agent can converse with (role-based grants for agent_converse).

cacheRetention.title: Cache retention
cacheRetention.description: Prompt caching retention policy for this agent. Null means provider default (short) is used.

thinking.title: Thinking level
thinking.description: Default reasoning effort this agent requests (validated against the model's capabilities).

contextWindow.title: Context window
contextWindow.description: Default context-window size (tokens) this agent requests (validated against the model's capabilities).

maxConcurrentSessions.title: Max concurrent sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.description: Maximum concurrent sessions for this agent.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this agent is enabled and available for routing.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Memory system configuration for this agent.

soul.title: Soul
soul.description: Soul session lifecycle configuration for this agent.

dateTimeInjection.title: Date time injection
dateTimeInjection.description: Datetime injection configuration override for this agent. Overrides world default when set.

sessionAccess.title: Session access
sessionAccess.description: Session access configuration for this agent's session tool.

conversationAccess.title: Conversation access
conversationAccess.description: Conversation access configuration for this agent's conversation tool.

fileAccess.title: File access
fileAccess.description: File access policy for this agent's file tools.

shellCommand.title: Shell command
shellCommand.description: Custom shell command array for this agent. Overrides the gateway-level ShellCommand. Element [0] is the executable, remaining elements are base arguments. The agent's command string is appended as the final argument.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Extension-specific configuration keyed by extension ID. Each extension reads its own section (e.g., "botnexus-skills", "botnexus-exec").

toolPolicy.title: Tool policy
toolPolicy.description: Tool policy overrides for this agent.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Optional. Kind of agent — currently only Named is accepted from config. SubAgent is rejected by AgentDescriptorValidator.ValidateForConfig; sub-agents are runtime-only and produced exclusively by DefaultSubAgentManager.SpawnAsync. Omit the field entirely on existing configs; the default is Named.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether persistent memory is enabled for this agent. When false, no memories are written or retrieved.

path.title: Path
path.description: Gets or sets the optional memory root or file override path.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.description: Settings controlling how new memories are embedded and indexed for later retrieval.

search.title: Search
search.description: Settings controlling how stored memories are searched and ranked at retrieval time.

promptInjection.title: Prompt injection
promptInjection.description: Gets or sets prompt-memory injection mode: full, summary, or none.

defaultTopK.title: Default top k
defaultTopK.description: Default number of memory results returned when a search does not request an explicit count.

maxTopK.title: Max top k
maxTopK.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of results an agent-supplied topK can request. Caller-provided values above this ceiling are clamped so a single search cannot fan out over the entire store; protects against runaway embedding fetches and oversized tool results.

maxLimit.title: Max limit
maxLimit.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of entries a memory_get session listing can return. Caller-provided limit values above this ceiling are clamped to bound the fetch and the resulting serialized payload.

temporalDecay.title: Temporal decay
temporalDecay.description: Settings that down-rank older memories so recent context scores higher.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether temporal decay is applied to memory search scores. When false, age does not affect ranking.

halfLifeDays.title: Half life days
halfLifeDays.description: Age in days at which a memory's relevance score is halved. Lower values forget faster.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether soul journalling is enabled for this agent, giving it a daily note and reflection cycle.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used to decide when the agent's day starts and ends (for example Europe/London).

dayBoundary.title: Day boundary
dayBoundary.description: Local time of day at which one journal day rolls over to the next, in HH:mm format.

reflectionOnSeal.title: Reflection on seal
reflectionOnSeal.description: Whether the agent writes a reflection when a day's journal is sealed.

reflectionPrompt.title: Reflection prompt
reflectionPrompt.description: Custom prompt used to generate the end-of-day reflection. When unset, the built-in prompt is used.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether heartbeat polling is enabled.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Custom heartbeat prompt. If null, uses the default: "Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists and execute any pending tasks. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.".

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Quiet hours configuration -- skip heartbeats during these hours.

activeHours.title: Active hours
activeHours.description: Active hours configuration -- restrict heartbeats to a time window. When set, the cron expression is generated to only fire within the specified window. Takes precedence over QuietHours for schedule generation.

ackMaxChars.title: Ack max chars
ackMaxChars.description: Maximum character length of an assistant response that can be classified as a heartbeat acknowledgement. Responses that contain "HEARTBEAT_OK" but are longer than this threshold are treated as substantive replies (not pruned). Default: 300.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether quiet hours are enabled.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start of quiet period (local time, format "HH:mm"). Default: "23:00".

end.title: End
end.description: End of quiet period (local time, format "HH:mm"). Default: "07:00".

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Timezone for quiet hours. Falls back to agent's soul timezone or "UTC".

start.title: Start
start.description: Start of active window (local time, "HH:mm"). Default: "08:00".

end.title: End
end.description: End of active window (local time, "HH:mm"). Default: "23:00". Must be strictly later than Start; midnight-spanning ranges are not supported.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for the active window. Falls back to agent soul timezone or UTC.

allowedAgents.title: Allowed agents
allowedAgents.description: Agent IDs this agent can view sessions for (when level is "allowlist").

allowedAgents.title: Allowed agents
allowedAgents.description: Agent IDs this agent can view conversations for (when level is "allowlist").

alwaysApprove.title: Always approve
alwaysApprove.description: Tools that always require approval regardless of default classification.

neverApprove.title: Never approve
neverApprove.description: Tools that skip approval even if classified as dangerous (trusted).

denied.title: Denied
denied.description: Tools completely blocked for this agent.

askFallback.title: Ask fallback
askFallback.description: Posture applied when a tool requires approval but no approval workflow can service the request (issue #2391). Accepted values are allow (default, historical behaviour -- execution proceeds with an audit record) and deny (fail closed -- the call is refused with an ask-fallback-deny reason).

askFallbackAllow.title: Ask fallback allow
askFallbackAllow.description: Tools exempted from AskFallback when it is deny. An approval-required tool named here falls back to allow instead of being refused, so a fail-closed agent can still keep a narrow set of tools working.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this provider is enabled. Disabled providers are hidden from the API.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for this provider, or a reference to an auth.json entry. Sensitive: stored and shown masked.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Optional base URL override for this provider's API endpoint.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Default model identifier used for this provider when an agent does not specify one.

models.title: Models
models.description: Allowed model IDs for this provider. Null means all models, empty means none.

input.title: Input
input.description: Explicit input modalities (for example ["text","image"]) for models registered from this provider's Models list. When null or empty the modalities are inferred from each model's family; an explicit declaration always wins. Previously these models were hardcoded to text-only, so a vision-capable local model silently discarded every image it was handed (#2485).

api.title: API
api.description: Optional API identifier used when registering models from this provider's Models list. Defaults to "openai-completions" for backward compatibility with config-driven OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.). Set to "integration-mock" or another registered provider's API name to register models against a different IApiProvider.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: PBI6 (#1707): explicit reasoning/thinking capability for models registered from this provider's Models list. When null (the default) the capability is inferred from each model's family so a known reasoning family (Claude 4+, GPT-5+, o3/o4, Gemini 3+, Grok-code) is picked up automatically; set it explicitly for a local model whose id the family heuristic does not recognise.

supportsExtraHighThinking.title: Supports extra high thinking
supportsExtraHighThinking.description: PBI6 (#1707): explicit extra-high (ExtraHigh / Max) thinking-tier capability for this provider's dynamic models. When null the value is inferred from the model family. Ignored (clamped off) for a model that does not support reasoning.

supportsExtendedContextWindow.title: Supports extended context window
supportsExtendedContextWindow.description: PBI6 (#1707): explicit extended (1M) context-window capability for this provider's dynamic models. When null the value is inferred from the model family (Anthropic-direct Claude Sonnet 4/4.5 and Opus 4.5). Drives the context-size picker's second (1M) tier.

contextWindow.title: Context window
contextWindow.description: PBI6 (#1707): default context-window size (in tokens) for this provider's dynamic models. When null a conservative 128000-token default is used. Sets the standard tier the context-size picker offers for a config-declared model.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this channel is enabled.

enabled.title: Enable cron
enabled.description: Whether the cron scheduler runs scheduled jobs.

tickIntervalSeconds.title: Tick interval (seconds)
tickIntervalSeconds.description: How often the scheduler wakes to evaluate due jobs, in seconds.

webhookBlockedHosts.title: Webhook blocked hosts
webhookBlockedHosts.description: Hostnames refused as cron webhook targets, in addition to the always-blocked loopback, private, link-local and cloud-metadata address ranges. Use for internal services on publicly-resolving names. Exact, case-insensitive host match.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Optional job definitions keyed by stable job ID.

name.title: Job name
name.description: Human-readable name shown for this job in schedules and run reports.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Five-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday) controlling when the job fires.

actionType.title: Action type
actionType.description: What the job does when it fires: agent-prompt sends a prompt to an agent; command runs a shell command.

agentId.title: Target agent
agentId.description: Agent that receives the prompt. Required for agent-prompt jobs.

message.title: Prompt message
message.description: Prompt text sent to the agent. Required for agent-prompt jobs unless a template is named.

templateName.title: Prompt template
templateName.description: Named prompt template rendered instead of a literal message.

templateParameters.title: Template parameters
templateParameters.description: Values substituted into the named prompt template's placeholders.

model.title: Model override
model.description: Model this job runs on, overriding the agent's configured model.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Destination URL called when the job fires. Used by webhook jobs.

shellCommand.title: Shell command
shellCommand.description: Command or script executed when the job fires. Runs with the gateway's privileges - treat as a dangerous operation.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this job fires on its schedule. A disabled job stays defined but never runs.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: Label recording who or what created this job. Used for auditing only.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form key/value entries persisted alongside the job, such as a timeout override.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the parameter must be supplied if no default exists.

maxReportFileSizeBytes.title: Max report file size bytes
maxReportFileSizeBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes read from a report file for portal preview. Files larger than this are truncated server-side and flagged in the UI. Defaults to 524288 (512 KB). Set to 0 for no server-side limit.
